notes.title: 12.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the first iteration of the end dragon “Archie” boss fight in the Mystal Zone after collecting all 9 shards.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would run in one direction.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when a remote player disconnects, their wild spawns wouldn’t auto-destroy.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could still hear other players’ attacks when not near them (SFX).
[*] Fixed a player interaction bug where players would lose the ability to interact with objects.
[*] Fixed a bug where the echo orb would respawn you in the sky while in the Nature Zone.
[*] Added a failsafe to prevent creature vault spawn spamming (sometimes duplicate creatures would spawn).
[*] Added a failsafe to prevent bond spamming and attack spamming.
[*] Added bond scroll logic back in.
[*] Added world gate hopping counter back in.
[*] Death consequences: death timer set to 10 seconds.
[*] Made wardens more obvious by adding map icons for their positions in each zone.
[*] Made warden pets non-interactable to avoid interfering with warden interactions.
[*] Adjusted pet follow logic so pets don’t get dragged around while flying.
[/list]

notes.title: 12.3 Release Notes (Minor Update)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Shopkeepers now sell zone hats, while quest givers grant you a trap of that zone type.
[*] If the player has a torch, melee attacks will use the torch instead of the lead pet.
[*] Banishing creatures now restores the entire party.
[*] Bonding a new creature fully heals it.
[*] The overhead dragon will occasionally move toward a random player to make contact more likely.
[*] If a remote player has PVP mode active, their map icon is disabled.
[/list]

notes.title: 12.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added overworld attacks to the overhead dragon shadow. (shoots fireballs at any player directly in front of him)
[*] Added Mystal Haven zone, accessed via the giant inactive portal in the Nature zone. Requires all 9 shards to activate (boss fight still in development :/)
[*] Added player emotes via the chat function! Type "backslash action", e.g., "/dance", "/cheer", "/sit", "/sleep", "/cry", etc.
[*] Added water reflections.
[*] Added random chests to each zone.
[*] Added scattered trainer camps throughout the world.
[*] Added Earth zone point of interest.
[*] Added innkeeper secrets/tips.
[*] Cleaned up flying mount air jumping a bit.
[*] Increased mouse rotation speed (will add option to adjust).
[*] Optimized toggling and VFX for each zone (e.g., only run campfires and gate VFX when the zone is active).
[*] Improved zone detection logic for traveling over mountains.
[*] Various fixes and adjustments throughout the world.
[/list]

notes.title: 12.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list][*][p][b]Creature Hats![/b]
Creatures can now wear hats from your inventory — including a persistent egg hat if you don’t claim it after hatching.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Open World[/b]
The entire map now loads automatically as one giant connected world — no more waiting for world generation.
Multiplayer players can freely explore any zone; they’re no longer locked to the host’s zone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fast Travel Panel[/b]
Added an in-world Fast Travel panel, accessible through the main menu, to quickly travel between zones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Scaling for Wardens[/b]
Warden and Keeper battles now automatically scale in difficulty based on your current shard count.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overhauled real-time combat: proper armor and deflect stat calculations, plus new dodge and crit chance mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Remote players now correctly sync Parry and Deflect moves.[/p][/*][*][p]Major backend balancing: higher-level creatures are less likely to die to much lower-level creatures.[/p][/*][*][p]New Bond Mechanic: creatures may break the bond and resist capture based on rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Added trainer camps across the map — battle more than just Wardens![/p][/*][*][p]Improved pet switching: Battle HUD now has buttons to switch pets or flee.[/p][/*][*][p]Better pet positioning in battles — no more pets sitting inside each other![/p][/*][*][p]Added starting zone selection for new characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added lava and water detection for mounts:[/p][list][*][p]Earth/Fire mounts grant lava immunity.[/p][/*][*][p]Flying mounts ignore water and lava damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mount improvements: flying mounts now have air jumps, boosted forward jumps, and sprint animations. Mount sprinting rolls have increased power.[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped UI: Dialogue, Quest, Shop, and Inspect panels all improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspect panel now shows full evolution tree with level requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “earned shards” panel to the bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased player inventory size.[/p][/*][*][p]Added full party heal option at town statues (“Pray”).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved pet level-up visual effects and evolution effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced and cleaned up SFX for summoning, leveling up, and healing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various menu control bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced creature viewer sizes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various sound/music balancing issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved split-screen lighting and remote zone NPC loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new town notifications and creature vault notifications.[/p][/*][*][p]Various behind-the-scenes optimizations for zone preloading.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thank you for all your helpful feedback and support! Sorry I took so long![/p]

notes.title: 11.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] World Collection Update: You can now find and bond every creature in each zone — a total of 513 to collect. The new Vault UI helps you keep track of your progress
[*] Vault Update: No longer locks. You can summon and recall creatures at any time
[*] Wild Creature Scaling: Wild creature levels now scale based on the first pet in the host’s party. Defaults to the minimum level range if no pets are summoned
[*] Zone Selection: Added to the Start Screen – choose which zone you'd like to explore at the beginning
[*] Collector and Healer are now combined into Mystic
[*] Runaway and Breeder are merged into simply Runaway
[*] Merchant and Veteran become Noble
[*] Each class now has two model variants and more utility
[*] (Don’t worry—any previous class/model save is preserved, and characters also receive the bonus from the newly combined class. For example, if you had a Collector before, your character now retains the Collector bonus plus the Healer bonus)
[*] New Feature: Added a Save File Delete Panel (Main Menu -> Options)
[*] Egg Hat Mechanic: Hatched creatures now keep their egg hat until level 15, when they evolve to the next stage
[*] Start Portal: Players now load into the map through a randomly placed start portal with a heal action
[*] Lots of World Generation tweaks: roads, varying floor heights, etc.
[*] Warden, Town, and Start location are now randomly placed on the map
[*] Chat Update: Added explicit language filter
[*] UI Overhaul: Most of the UI has been updated with a new dark cute theme. Some elements are still being finalized
[*] New Achievement: Universal Collector – Bond with every Mystling at every stage, across every type
[*] New Achievement: Adventure is Out There – Explore ten different zones in a single play session
[/list]

Thank you for all the helpful feedback! The game is really coming together.

notes.title: 10.2 Release Notes: Player Chat Added
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added player chat! (Keyboard only – press Enter to open chat and start typing.)
[*] Fixed an issue where quest-giver data wasn’t being initialized for remote players.
[*] Updated Collector Elite map icons so they now appear above the map fog.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented dropped items from syncing properly.
[/list]

notes.title: 9.9 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added random matchmaking! I’ll likely need to patch as issues arise.
[*] Added an Overworld PvP toggle to the main menu. The player HUD now displays a PvP icon when it’s active—this lets you attack wild creatures with friends without accidentally hitting each other.
[*] Added multiplayer lobby types: Open (anyone can join), Friends Only, or Closed (no one, including friends, can join).
[*] Added hand equips for players. First hand item: torches.
[*] Added an option to release a pet. Your pet remains spawned but is no longer owned by you—it can be attacked or caught by another player (although it’s pretty sad).
[*] The game now auto-saves every ~30 seconds.
[*] Selecting any one of your pets now selects them all, making healing and pet-management interactions a little easier.
[*] Interact options now cycle through the list (e.g., press “up” at the top to go to the bottom), for easier navigation.
[*] Added the ability to carry fallen creatures that aren’t yours.
[*] Added character model specific map icons for remote players (less confusing who is who).
[*] Re-arranged the world-zone grid.
[*] Added proper character icons for Soldier and Merchant models.
[*] Added a double-tap “Cancel” to quit a player challenge.
[*] Cleaned up hat-mesh positioning on the Breeder and Healer models.
[*] Minor network and optimization tweaks (should reduce interaction errors when playing online).
[*] Fixed remote-pet melee attacks: animation and damage type now sync properly.
[*] Fixed a level-gained bug that showed “leveled up” on all pets, even when only one actually leveled.
[*] Fixed an issue where first-zone spawn levels didn’t match the player’s shard count.
[*] Added a safety net to respawn players back home if they fall through the earth and keep falling indefinitely.
[/list]

notes.title: 9.8 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Doubled creature spawn rates in each zone to make them feel more populated.
[*] Reduced the “Dancing Plague” achievement requirement to 300 minutes (previously 25 hours). This better reflects the historical 60‑day plague, given that each in‑game day is 5 minutes.
[*] Fixed an issue where players or pets could occasionally become stuck underground.
[*] When inspecting a creature, you can now press ◀️/▶️ to cycle through your party and compare stats more easily.
[*] Updated the POV and Battle cameras: you can now rotate and zoom during creature inspections, egg‑hatching, or battles.
[*] Removed mesh hiding for pets during battles and while riding mounts, so your pets now remain visible.
[*] Added floating damage text in battles to show attack effectiveness.
[*] Wardens and Keepers will now acknowledge if they’ve already been challenged.
[*] Resolved startup problems caused by weak or missing internet connections—offline play should now work reliably.
[*] Added a small HUD notification when a creature levels up.
[*] Added a new firepit model to the prefab.
[*] Adjusted the sizes of certain Teen/Adult creatures (e.g., Laski, Scorplin).
[*] Fixed the zone creature catch‑count bug.
[*] Fixed the EXP‑bar initialization bug at the start of battles.
[/list]

[b]Upcoming:
Random Matchmaking: Join random players' worlds or let them to join yours.[/b]

notes.title: 9.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the first round of quests. Zone quests are given by the townsperson in each zone.
[*] Added hats that can be earned by completing zone quests.
[*] Added backpacks that can be purchased from the shopkeeper.
[*] Some creatures drop creature-specific loot; for example, Pixsnap Dust can be collected by banishing a Pixsnap.
[*] Added new zone music for Basic, Earth, Light, Water, and Wind zones.
[*] Added a new basic achievement: Revive another player.
[*] Added a new basic achievement: Challenge another player.
[*] Added a new basic achievement: Breed two pets together.
[*] Added a new legendary achievement: Dancing Plague – Dance for 1,518 minutes without stopping.
[*] Lowered the Treasure Hunter achievement requirement from collecting 25 chests to 10 chests in a play session.
[*] The zone you start in is based on the secondary type of your starting creature. If you choose "Default," then the starting zone will be Basic.
[*] Fixed a bug where a remote player's battle sounds could be heard across the map.
[*] Cleaned up riding roots and attack roots for all creatures to help fix the attack VFX positions and player riding positions.
[*] Fixed creature gravity to reduce clipping with hills and cliffs.
[*] Cleaned up pet follow rotation so that pets don't immediately snap into position.
[*] Fixed a bug where Deflect and Parry sometimes weren't functioning correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the zone complete message would repeat.
[/list]

notes.title: 9.61 Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reversed HP scaling with level. This was causing high-level battles to be extremely slow. I will do a proper balance fix as soon as possible.
[/list]

notes.title: 9.6 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new Wind-type bird Mystling named Squalli, available in baby, teen, and adult variants along with all elemental materials. Find it in the Wind zone.
[*] Added a new Basic-type bunny Mystling named Zoezoe, available in baby, teen, and adult variants along with all elemental materials. Find it in the Basic zone.
[*] Added new Steam achievement: World Collector - Bond every Mystling at every stage.
[*] Added new Steam achievement: Shard Lord - Earn all nine elemental shards.
[*] Added new Steam achievement: Treasure Hunter - Open 25 chests in a single play session.
[*] Added new Steam achievement: Dance Master - Dance for ten minutes without stopping.
[*] Added new Steam achievement: Food Bond - Feed a wild Mystling ten times to bond them.
[*] Balanced health stats so that low level Mystlings are less likely to defeat high level Mystlings. Although, it's still possible.
[*] New characters now start in a random zone instead of defaulting to the Nature zone.
[*] Added a map grid key to the world map so you can see where each zone is located. 
[*] Changed teen stage level to 15 and adult stage level to 35.
[*] Innkeepers now sell basic items.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from starting a new game when not connected to the internet.
[*] Fixed a bug that placed players in the wall when booking a room at the inn.
[*] Made various tweaks and bug fixes throughout the game.
[*] Upcoming: I hope to add simple quests, new player accessories (such as hats), and quality-of-life improvements in the next update. Thank you for playing!
[/list]

notes.title: 9.51 Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to spawn in the ground after changing zones.
[*] Added playtime to the save file.
[*] Modified the character select UI to be a bit more clear.
[/list]

notes.title: 9.5 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Officially added player victory consequences for defeating another player in a challenge: steal all their gold, rename the other player, steal a random shard, or show mercy.
[*] Synced pet renaming: other players will now see your pet’s new nickname instantly.
[*] Wild creatures will follow you briefly if you feed them.
[*] Wild creatures can be bonded by feeding them plenty of their favorite food.
[*] Added unique water zones (used to share assets with Frost).
[*] Added unique basic zones (used to share assets with Nature).
[*] Added unique earth zones (used to share assets with Fire).
[*] Added unique light zones (used to share assets with Nature).
[*] Modified creature spawns per zone and added a progress bar for each zone so you know when you’ve caught all available creatures before moving on.
[*] Added a gamepad UI toggle for the hotkey bar (vault, bag, map, switch).
[*] Adjusted the size of some stage 3 creatures (some were a bit too small).
[*] Added a maximum size cap for creatures (level 100) so they don’t become too large to fit on screen.
[*] Tweaked level ranges to increment by 7 (e.g., 7–14, 14–21, etc.).
[*] Increased stage 2 level to 20 and stage 3 level to 40.
[*] Included a total shard count and the current active level range next to shards in the Vault UI (bottom middle).
[*] Eggs are now synced, so remote players will receive the correct babies based on the parent(s).
[*] Steam achievements, new creatures, and more coming soon!
[*] Real Life News: Our baby is due any day now! Wish us luck :)
[/list]

notes.title: 9.4 Release Notes Cleaning Network Bugs!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed numerous network bugs that were causing game-breaking issues. Hopefully, you won’t run into too many problems!
[*] Updated the character select screen to display your pet’s current stage instead of defaulting to Stage 1.
[*] Fixed a significant EXP bug.
[*] Increased the volume for many creatures with quiet cries. Additionally, added distinct baby, kid, and adult versions for each cry.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck Verification in the Works
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I just wanted to share a quick update. I've been testing Mystal Haven on a Steam Deck, and things are looking pretty good so far. I'm in the process of getting the game verified for Steam Deck compatibility by Valve.

If you have a Deck, feel free to give it a try. 

Thanks for all the support, and I'll keep you posted on any updates!

- Todd

notes.title: 9.3 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Creatures now grow slightly larger with each level (Level 100 creatures are huge).
[*] Dancing now gives you a bit of EXP every 5 seconds.
[*] Added a creature feeding system—each creature has a specific food that restores HP and gives EXP (potions still work).
[*] Refactored EXP logic so you can level up multiple times in one go (excess EXP carries over).
[*] Removed the Gold limit.
[*] Created unique Wind zones with a high-mountain setting (used to share zone info with Shadow).
[*] All creatures now have a unique cry.
[*] Refactored interact logic to prioritize the most-facing selectable over the closest.
[*] Added interact highlight for selecting creatures.
[*] Added "Q" button visual to toggle the lead pet.
[*] Added town music and town names.
[*] Fixed map positioning.
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped remote players from buying items in the shop.
[*] Fixed a volume bug.
[*] Fixed pet positioning issues after dodging in battle.
[*] Fixed the infinite climbing issue at the top.
[*] Fixed realm gate icon syncing with remote players.
[*] Added a medium volume setting (Low, Med, High, Muted).
[*] Lowered SFX volume for battle attack sounds.
[*] Made various UI cleanups throughout the game.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.95 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed the shard requirement for accessing other zones.
[*] Enabled overworld PvP.
[*] Added player climbing (face cliff and jump to start).
[*] Increased EXP gains for early levels.
[*] Added an EXP bar with a gain effect in the Battle HUD.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.9 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] World triggers now teleport you to the opposite side of the map instead of loading a new zone.
[*] NPC battles have been slowed down a bit.
[*] Online join now shows only friends who are in-game and in a lobby.
[*] Added Bag, Map, and Vault buttons to the gameplay overlay for easier navigation.
[*] Updated the “How to Play” wood background graphic for a cleaner look.
[*] Added custom sounds for about half the creatures.
[*] Updated the Shadow/Wind zone music to a more upbeat tune.
[*] Fixed an issue where some pets would disappear when changing havens.
[*] Corrected haven changes so your world position now syncs correctly.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.8 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added "How to Play" instructions to the pause menu and on an interactable sign at the start of the game to help new players get started.
[*] New players now start with a pet at level 5. They also start with more potions, scrolls, and revives for a better early-game experience.
[*] Various bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Revamped Starting Zone: Enhanced layout for hopefully improved early-game experience.
[*] Added POV camera angles when interacting with creatures, hatching eggs, and talking to the shopkeeper.
[*] Newly hatched creatures and level 1 creatures now have an egg hat.
[*] Increased spacing for pets following the player to reduce clutter when three pets are active.
[*] PVP Battles: Move, switch, and lose events are now properly synced across the network.
[*] Fixed an issue where switching pets wouldn't occur if the current leader was at full health.
[*] Fixed a bug where aggressive creatures were attacking players while they were already in battle.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.5 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased the radius and range for overworld attacks. As long as you're facing your target and you're close enough, your hit should connect.
[*] Added a safeguard to stop you from vaulting your active pet when the vault is locked.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused issues when joining the game in split-screen mode, exiting to the main menu, and then restarting the game.
[*] Added new riding music that plays while you're riding one of your pets.
[*] Tweaked the default music-to-SFX volume ratios and added separate toggles for each.
[*] Increased camera lighting by about 15%.
[*] Disabled camera panning/rotating while the shop panel is active.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Demo Online Support: The demo build now supports online play.
[*] Pet Bonding: When bonding a new pet, if there’s room in your party, they join immediately instead of being sent to the vault.
[*] Creature Stats Refactor: All creatures have been grouped into specific stat categories (e.g., Might Wall, Might Sweeper, Surge Wall, Surge Sweeper, Surge Might, Wall Wall, etc).
[*] New Item: Echo Orb: A new starting item that returns you to your home. Just talk to the Innkeeper to set your inn as home—handy when you’re lost in the wilds.
[*] New item: Mini Portable Vault: Now available in the shop (works a bit like tents).
[*] Custom Pet Nicknames(Note: you’ll need to use the on-screen keyboard.)
[*] Vaults now close automatically after use, so you don’t have to manually close and re-open them.
[*] -Added missing sound effects (chest open, vault open, drink, pet heal, etc)
[/list]
